pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

views.hidden: what a judge does not see is set to zero in normalised units, after the frame is drawn; both judges see the whole frame

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: person H: plus network, mu = 1, half A, left half of the image; the same at the three overlaps
keys.z_M: log-odds of each machine on its own (not the sum with H), shape (3, N), rows in the order of `machines`; for Mramo z_M0 + z_branch
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames, the same at the three overlaps
manifest.machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class

machines.M0: cross-entropy on half B, on the machine's half of the image
machines.Mramo: M0 frozen (eval mode) plus a branch that sees only the frame, trained from scratch on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_M0 + z_branch (H on its half of the image, M0 on its own, no gradient); recorded cue z_M0 + z_branch
machines.Mpair: a new network on the machine's half of the image, trained from scratch on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_M (H frozen); same seed, batch order, crops, flips and frames as M0

manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: H crc32('views/<task>/s<seed>/H') & 0x7fffffff; M0 and Mpair crc32('views/<task>/s<seed>/M'); the branch crc32('views/<task>/s<seed>/ramo'): the same at the three overlaps

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

deviations: shared GPU: the driver stopped twice to give the GPU back to another user and started again when it was free. Three sessions on 2026-11-19, UTC: 09:49 to 10:15, 10:19 to 11:27, 19:20 to 20:13. A unit is written when it ends; the units under way at a stop were run again from the start, with the same seeds. stage_time is the last session only: the seconds of each unit are in unit_seconds

51 units were written in the second session, 24 in the third. In the second session one of the three processes stopped after its first unit; its log was overwritten by the third session, so the cause is not recorded. Its other 24 units ran in the third session, one process on the GPU
environment built again for these runs: numpy 2.5.5 (E1 to E5: 2.5.4); python, torch, torchvision, CUDA and cuDNN as in E1 to E5

settings.differences: machine minus M0 at the same overlap, paired on the same resamples

V1.rule: where the views do not overlap, the tuned pair (H, Mramo) is more sensitive than the tuned pair (H, M0): interval of the difference above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

V2.rule: the median of that difference grows as the overlap falls (0 > 50 > 100 per cent), and where the views are the same it is at most 0.333333 of what it is where they do not overlap

V3.rule: where the views do not overlap, Mramo alone is less sensitive than M0 alone (interval below zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5) and V1 passes

V4.rule: d_a(Mpair alone) / d_a(M0 alone), median over the units: >= 0.7 where the views do not overlap, <= 0.3 where they are the same, and decreasing with the overlap

V5.rule: where the views do not overlap, the tuned pair (H, Mramo) is more sensitive than M0 alone: interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

V6.rule: where the views do not overlap, at face value (raw log-odds added) the pair (H, Mramo) is more sensitive than the pair (H, M0): interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5
